answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become central to software engineering workflows, powering tools for code generation, program repair, test case generation, debugging, and beyond, significantly boosting developers' productivity.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates LLMs on equivalence checking, which involves assessing whether two programs are semantically equivalent, focusing on reasoning about program behavior rather than generating free-form natural language or code.
